context: Daichi and Riku queue for a festival ride.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (かける/列/探す/おっしゃる/乗る) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: あの乗り物、乗ってみたい!
lines.en: I want to ride that attraction!
lines.style: excited teen boy voice, bright warm eager delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: おお、ええな。けど列が長いで。
lines.en: Oh, nice. But the line's long.
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm hearty delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 空いてる入口、探そうよ。
lines.en: Let's look for an empty entrance.
lines.style: animated teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 係の人が、こっちやとおっしゃってたで。
lines.en: The attendant said it's this way.
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 並ぶのに、時間かけちゃうね。
lines.en: We'll spend time waiting in line.
lines.style: rueful teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 時間かけても、乗る価値あるで。
lines.en: Even spending time, it's worth riding.
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 列の先頭が、見えてきたよ!
lines.en: I can see the front of the line!
lines.style: thrilled teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: よっしゃ、もうすぐ乗れるで!
lines.en: Alright, we'll get to ride soon!
lines.style: warm Kansai man voice, warm hearty closing delivery throughout
